name: PS1-12bqh and PS1-12bqi field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the Pan-STARRS supernova candidates PS1-12bqh and PS1-12bqi, seen by Hubble.
label: ps112bqhandps112bqifield-hubble
story: Hubble pointed between two faint transients found in Pan-STARRS fields. The RAISIN program followed distant Type Ia supernovae in infrared light, where they behave more like standard candles, to trace the history of cosmic expansion.

claims.text: The Hubble program 13046 target SN02 is a pointing between PS1-12bqh and PS1-12bqi
RAISIN followed up SN Ia discovered in Pan-STARRS fields with WFC3/IR to trace cosmic expansion
SN Ia are more nearly standard candles in the near-infrared bands
